west_bengal.name: West Bengal
west_bengal.routing_note: State containment enables a neutral West Bengal grievance handoff after the exact KMC check; it does not identify a road owner or ULB.
limitations: The OpenStreetMap boundary is a routing aid, not a legal boundary record.
The state grievance portal requires the user to select and verify the responsible department.
Municipal, PWD, panchayat, NHAI and other ownership is not inferred.

kmc.scope: Current KMC municipal limits in the source WFS snapshot
